w0 = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')  # wheel in assembly pose

print('w bounds', w0.bounds, 'vol', w0.volume)
print('b bounds', b0.bounds, 'vol', b0.volume)

    try:

        v = float(inter.volume)
